title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Frontdoor Custom Domain module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-cdnfrontdoorcustomdomain'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cdn_frontdoor_profile_id.description: (Required) The name id of the frontdoor profile.

cdn_frontdoor_secret_id.description: (Optional) Resource ID of the Front Door Secret.

certificate_type.description: (Optional) Defines the source of the SSL certificate.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

dns_zone_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Azure DNS Zone which should be used for this Front Door Custom Domain. If you are using Azure to host your DNS domains, you must delegate the domain provider's domain name system (DNS) to an Azure DNS Zone.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

host_name.description: (Required) The host name of the domain. The host_name field must be the FQDN of your domain.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

expiration_date.description: The Expiration date of created CDN Frontdoor custom domain.

id.description: The ID of the created CDN Frontdoor custom domain.

name.description: The name of the created CDN Frontdoor custom domain.

resource.description: The Cdn Frontdoor Custom Domain resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Cdnfrontdoorcustomdomain' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
